_about: Questions with hand-written gold SQL for the B2B pipeline sample (seed_pipeline.py). Gold queries follow config/pipeline.md: pipeline is dated by created_at, won revenue and win rate by closed_at, and two fact tables are never joined row by row. Written independently of the offline engine, in a different style (subqueries, CTEs, substr dates, CASE). kind: 'template' = a shape the offline engine is meant to cover, 'beyond' = needs the AI mode.

questions.question: Pipeline by channel
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, ROUND(SUM(d.amount_eur), 2) FROM channels ch JOIN deals d ON d.channel_id = ch.id GROUP BY ch.id

questions.question: Which channel brought the most pipeline in Q3 2026?
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, ROUND(SUM(d.amount_eur), 2) AS p FROM channels ch JOIN deals d ON d.channel_id = ch.id WHERE substr(d.created_at, 1, 7) IN ('2026-07', '2026-08', '2026-09') GROUP BY ch.id ORDER BY p DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Monthly pipeline from LinkedIn
questions.gold: SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 7), ROUND(SUM(amount_eur), 2) FROM deals WHERE channel_id = (SELECT id FROM channels WHERE name = 'LinkedIn Ads') GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Win rate by segment
questions.gold: WITH closed AS (SELECT account_id, CASE WHEN stage = 'closed_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won FROM deals WHERE stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')) SELECT a.segment, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(closed.won) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM closed JOIN accounts a ON a.id = closed.account_id GROUP BY a.segment

questions.question: Top 5 campaigns by won revenue
questions.gold: SELECT ca.name, ROUND(SUM(d.amount_eur), 2) AS r FROM campaigns ca JOIN deals d ON d.campaign_id = ca.id WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won' GROUP BY ca.id ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: MQL rate by channel
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(c.mql_at) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM contacts c JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = c.channel_id GROUP BY ch.id

questions.question: Ad spend by channel in 2026
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, ROUND(SUM(sp.cost_eur), 2) FROM ad_spend sp JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.id = sp.campaign_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = ca.channel_id WHERE sp.spend_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY ch.id

questions.question: Open pipeline by stage
questions.gold: SELECT stage, ROUND(SUM(amount_eur), 2) FROM deals WHERE stage IN ('discovery', 'demo', 'proposal', 'negotiation') GROUP BY stage

questions.question: How many deals did we win in Q2 2026?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND substr(closed_at, 1, 7) IN ('2026-04', '2026-05', '2026-06')

questions.question: Average deal size by industry
questions.gold: SELECT a.industry, ROUND(AVG(d.amount_eur), 2) FROM accounts a JOIN deals d ON d.account_id = a.id WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won' GROUP BY a.industry

questions.question: Sales cycle by segment
questions.gold: WITH won AS (SELECT account_id, julianday(closed_at) - julianday(created_at) AS days FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won') SELECT a.segment, ROUND(AVG(won.days), 1) FROM won JOIN accounts a ON a.id = won.account_id GROUP BY a.segment

questions.question: Leads by channel in September 2026
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, COUNT(*) FROM contacts c JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = c.channel_id WHERE substr(c.created_at, 1, 7) = '2026-09' GROUP BY ch.id

questions.question: MQLs per month
questions.gold: SELECT substr(mql_at, 1, 7), COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE mql_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Website sessions by channel
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, SUM(s.sessions) FROM ga4_sessions s JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = s.channel_id GROUP BY ch.id

questions.question: Conversion rate by device
questions.gold: SELECT device, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(conversions) / SUM(sessions), 2) FROM ga4_sessions GROUP BY device

questions.question: Which campaign has the highest CTR?
questions.gold: SELECT ca.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(sp.clicks) / SUM(sp.impressions), 2) AS ctr FROM campaigns ca JOIN ad_spend sp ON sp.campaign_id = ca.id GROUP BY ca.id ORDER BY ctr DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Cost per click by campaign
questions.gold: SELECT ca.name, ROUND(SUM(sp.cost_eur) / SUM(sp.clicks), 2) FROM campaigns ca JOIN ad_spend sp ON sp.campaign_id = ca.id GROUP BY ca.id

questions.question: Pipeline by channel type
questions.gold: SELECT ch.kind, ROUND(SUM(d.amount_eur), 2) FROM deals d JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = d.channel_id GROUP BY ch.kind

questions.question: Won revenue by owner in 2026
questions.gold: SELECT owner, ROUND(SUM(amount_eur), 2) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND closed_at LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY owner

questions.question: Pipeline from paid channels by month
questions.gold: SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 7), ROUND(SUM(amount_eur), 2) FROM deals WHERE channel_id IN (SELECT id FROM channels WHERE kind = 'paid') GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Win rate for enterprise deals
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 'closed_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM deals WHERE stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND account_id IN (SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE segment = 'Enterprise')

questions.question: Top 3 accounts by pipeline
questions.gold: SELECT a.name, ROUND(SUM(d.amount_eur), 2) AS p FROM accounts a JOIN deals d ON d.account_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY p DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many opportunities came from Google Ads in 2026?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE created_at LIKE '2026%' AND channel_id = (SELECT id FROM channels WHERE name = 'Google Ads')

questions.question: Revenue from the UK
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_eur), 2) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND account_id IN (SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE country = 'United Kingdom')

questions.question: Engagement rate by channel
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.engaged_sessions) / SUM(s.sessions), 1) FROM ga4_sessions s JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = s.channel_id GROUP BY ch.id

questions.question: Deals lost by channel
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, COUNT(*) FROM deals d JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = d.channel_id WHERE d.stage = 'closed_lost' GROUP BY ch.id

questions.question: Mobile sessions by channel
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, SUM(s.sessions) FROM ga4_sessions s JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = s.channel_id WHERE s.device = 'mobile' GROUP BY ch.id

questions.question: Leads by job title
questions.gold: SELECT job_title, COUNT(*) FROM contacts GROUP BY job_title

questions.question: Traffic from organic search by month
questions.gold: SELECT substr(session_date, 1, 7), SUM(sessions) FROM ga4_sessions WHERE channel_id = (SELECT id FROM channels WHERE name = 'Organic Search') GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Which industry has the best win rate?
questions.gold: SELECT a.industry, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'closed_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS wr FROM deals d JOIN accounts a ON a.id = d.account_id WHERE d.stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY a.industry ORDER BY wr DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the cost per opportunity by channel?
questions.gold: WITH spend AS (SELECT ca.channel_id, SUM(sp.cost_eur) AS spend_eur FROM ad_spend sp JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.id = sp.campaign_id GROUP BY ca.channel_id), opps AS (SELECT channel_id, COUNT(*) AS deals FROM deals GROUP BY channel_id) SELECT ch.name, ROUND(spend.spend_eur / opps.deals, 2) FROM spend JOIN opps ON opps.channel_id = spend.channel_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = spend.channel_id

questions.question: Which paid channel returns the most pipeline per euro of ad spend?
questions.gold: WITH spend AS (SELECT ca.channel_id, SUM(sp.cost_eur) AS spend_eur FROM ad_spend sp JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.id = sp.campaign_id GROUP BY ca.channel_id), pipe AS (SELECT channel_id, SUM(amount_eur) AS pipeline_eur FROM deals GROUP BY channel_id) SELECT ch.name, ROUND(pipe.pipeline_eur / spend.spend_eur, 1) AS per_eur FROM spend JOIN pipe ON pipe.channel_id = spend.channel_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = spend.channel_id ORDER BY per_eur DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the ROAS of each paid channel?
questions.gold: WITH spend AS (SELECT ca.channel_id, SUM(sp.cost_eur) AS spend_eur FROM ad_spend sp JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.id = sp.campaign_id GROUP BY ca.channel_id), won AS (SELECT channel_id, SUM(amount_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' GROUP BY channel_id) SELECT ch.name, ROUND(won.revenue_eur / spend.spend_eur, 2) FROM spend JOIN won ON won.channel_id = spend.channel_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = spend.channel_id

questions.question: What is the cost per MQL by campaign?
questions.gold: WITH spend AS (SELECT campaign_id, SUM(cost_eur) AS spend_eur FROM ad_spend GROUP BY campaign_id), mqls AS (SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM contacts WHERE mql_at IS NOT NULL AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY campaign_id) SELECT ca.name, ROUND(spend.spend_eur / mqls.n, 2) FROM spend JOIN mqls ON mqls.campaign_id = spend.campaign_id JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.id = spend.campaign_id

questions.question: What share of pipeline comes from paid channels?
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ch.kind = 'paid' THEN d.amount_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(d.amount_eur), 1) FROM deals d JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = d.channel_id

questions.question: Compare pipeline in Q2 2026 vs Q3 2026 by channel
questions.gold: SELECT ch.name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(d.created_at, 1, 7) IN ('2026-04', '2026-05', '2026-06') THEN d.amount_eur ELSE 0 END), 2), ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(d.created_at, 1, 7) IN ('2026-07', '2026-08', '2026-09') THEN d.amount_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM deals d JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = d.channel_id GROUP BY ch.id

questions.question: Which accounts have more than one open deal?
questions.gold: SELECT a.name, COUNT(*) FROM deals d JOIN accounts a ON a.id = d.account_id WHERE d.stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

questions.question: Show the funnel from lead to MQL to deal to won, by channel
questions.gold: WITH leads AS (SELECT channel_id, COUNT(*) AS leads, COUNT(mql_at) AS mqls FROM contacts GROUP BY channel_id), opps AS (SELECT channel_id, COUNT(*) AS deals, SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 'closed_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won FROM deals GROUP BY channel_id) SELECT ch.name, leads.leads, leads.mqls, opps.deals, opps.won FROM leads JOIN opps ON opps.channel_id = leads.channel_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = leads.channel_id

questions.question: Which campaigns spent money but never produced a won deal?
questions.gold: SELECT ca.name FROM campaigns ca WHERE ca.id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM ad_spend) AND ca.id NOT IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL)

questions.question: How did monthly pipeline change compared to the previous month?
questions.gold: WITH m AS (SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(amount_eur) AS p FROM deals GROUP BY 1) SELECT cur.month, ROUND(cur.p, 2), ROUND(cur.p - prev.p, 2) FROM m cur JOIN m prev ON prev.month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM m WHERE month < cur.month)
